message: 親友と幼馴染み

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sweets Club, assemble!」

name: Sally
message: 「Heeey~」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I felt a spacey, cheerful vibe coming from over here, and sure enough, it's Sacchin」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's some hard-to-fathom sensory ability, but as expected of Lord Synn」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan is super busy with the Student Council! Therefore, as vice president, I'm taking command temporarily!」

name: Sally
message: 「Heeey~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Your voice is too quiet!」

name: Sally
message: 「Heeeey~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Assemble'? There's only two of you!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nuh-uh, including Yumil, there's three of us! Look over there, she's by the neighborhood association bulletin board, see?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, you're right」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahem! When three people gather, it's mon... mon... ummm?」

name: Sally
message: 「Mon-mon?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's right! I've been counting the restless, agonizing nights because Nana-chan hasn't been hanging out with me lately!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And this is all your fault, Synn-kun! You heartbreaker!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why am I suddenly getting blamed?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, what's a 'heartbreaker'? Is it tasty?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hell yeah! It's the best sashimi in all three realms!」

name: Sally
message: 「Sounds delicious. I wanna eat it~ *slurp*」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't think that's it, probably」

name: Yumil
message: 「Sacchin-senpai, I finished putting up the KiraFes posters!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that what you were doing? Thanks, Okamoto-san」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir! No need to thank me, though. I was just asked to do it by Yuugiri-senpai」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, thank you」

name: Synn
message: 「That's so like Nanaka. All sorts of people from the neighborhood come to this park, after all. It'll be super effective」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? Looking closely, isn't the color tone of this poster different from the others...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good work, Yumil-- Well then--, let's get our own activity started too--」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh--, I wanna eat something yummy already, wanna eat, wanna eat, wanna eat」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahem--! Now then, let's begin today's Heart-Throbbing Taste-Testing Meeting!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Today's topic. Ta-da! Are cheap candies considered sweets or not--!?」
Sacchin takes a brown paper bag out of her bag and hands out cheap candies to everyone.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Is it okay for me to get some too?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe--. I bought them with Nana-chan's wallet, so it's totally fine--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What's Nana-chan's is mine. What's mine is mine. This is decreed by the Code of Hammurabi--」

name: Sally
message: 「That's awesome」

name: Synn
message: 「No it's not, definitely not」
Looking closely at the paper bag, the shop's name is stamped on it by hand.

name: Synn
message: 「I recognize this. How nostalgic. When we were little, we all used to go to that candy shop tucked away in the back alleys of the residential area」

name: Yumil
message: 「That shop is still alive and kicking, yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep--, students on their way home from club activities buy oden and stuff there and eat it in this park--」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, even when the school issued a ban on buying snacks on the way home, everyone still kept going」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And on top of that, Ryuusei Academy went and lifted the ban--. A bold and brilliant decision by the chairwoman--」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks for the food--! Nom nom」

name: Sally
message: 「Slurp-slurp, haah--! This half-frozen, bright red jelly is so good--」

name: Yumil
message: 「That one's strawberry flavor」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Grape flavor is purple, and melon flavor is yellow-green--」

name: Paqy
message: 「A lump of artificial junk, huh. I see, no way we could eat this if Soba were around」

name: Synn
message: 「And fake plum mints that turn your tongue green when you eat them」

name: Yumil
message: 「Broken ramen bits that actually taste worse if you add hot water」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Color-changing jawbreaker candy where flavor is an afterthought」

name: Sally
message: 「Some flat, mysterious deep-fried snack. So yummyyy~♪」
Everyone gets absorbed in rummaging through the cheap snacks.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks for the food~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now hear me, my underlings~ I shall state my conclusion~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The one true truth lies within your own heart~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「So basically, as long as you think it tastes good, anything goes?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehe, ehehehe~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hello, Nana-chan~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah. We're properly doing sweets-related activities, so it's fine. Don't worry~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See ya~, we'll meet up with you later~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, today's activity is a secret just between us」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir. Truth is, I love keeping secrets」

name: Sally
message: 「As long as it's yummy, anything's fine~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everyone, now that we've filled our bellies, let's head over to Nana-chan's place to report~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「But before that, a top-secret mission~ Rummage, rummage in my pocket...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ta-da-da-daa~♪ Just your everyday store-bought highlighter~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I get it now」

name: Paqy
message: 「Get what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Earlier, you said the colors on the poster looked different, right? Nanaka must've used a highlighter on the Sweets Club's section」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ding-dong~ You're not my childhood friend for nothing~」

name: Synn
message: 「What's more, around tonight, Nanaka's going to think something like this」

name: Synn
message: 「'Making only our club stand out isn't fair! I'm gonna compete fair and square after all!'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And so, she comes all the way here in the middle of the night with an eraser, right, only to realize you can't erase highlighter ink.」

name: Synn
message: 「And then, after agonizing over it--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She ends up highlighting every single club!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you really are Nanaka's best friend, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Nights have been getting cold lately, so let's go ahead and do it ourselves right now.」

name: Sally
message: 「Can we draw doodles on it too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course! Lots of smiley faces and stars.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir!」
In the afternoon sunlight, we made the poster fair and square.
Sacchin secretly drew a big flower-shaped circle around the Sweets Club, though that much was just part of the charm.
